ruleDefinitions.name: Multifactor Authentication Interrupted
ruleDefinitions.description: Identifies user login with multifactor authentication failures, which might be an indication an attacker has the password for the account but can't pass the MFA challenge. Note: Unmapped fields: ResultType, ResultDescription

sequences.query: ((ResultType = 50074 AND ResultDescription = RGX(".*Strong\\ Auth\\ required.*")) OR (ResultType = 500121 AND ResultDescription = RGX(".*Authentication\\ failed\\ during\\ strong\\ authentication\\ request.*")))
